headline: Grants Committee discussed 2026 application process, grant maximums, and eligibility guidelines
summary: The committee reviewed the 2025 grant application and reporting process to consider updates for 2026. They discussed whether to change the $5,000 maximum grant amount and whether to revise who can apply. They agreed to review the decision rubric at a future meeting.
